title: Bora Employer Pipeline Qualification Gate Record
description: ALTERNATIVE_QUALIFICATION_BRANCH_REPRESENTATION_V1: an Employer-truth record representing employer-stated alternative qualification-branch composition (e.g. 'any ONE of these education/experience combinations satisfies this posting's degree gate'). Requirement rows remain atomic and unmodified; this record composes them via logic_expression only. Carries NO candidate Evidence/Claim/match-specific state -- distinct from src/requirement_source_role.py's per-row derive_qualification_gate() eligibility view (see the ADR's permanent terminology note).

qualification_gate_id.description: Permanent identifier for this gate within the analyzed job.

job_id.description: Job_ID of the job record this gate belongs to.

source_text.description: Array of exact raw-source excerpts, not a single synthetic combined sentence. Each excerpt must be deterministically traceable (exact substring after whitespace-only normalization) to the job's captured jd.txt -- see src/qualification_gate.py::validate_gate_source_traceability. Never paraphrased or merged into invented connective wording.

source_location.description: Location of the supporting wording within the job description (e.g. 'Minimum Qualifications + Substitutions').

logic_expression.description: Recursive boolean expression over Requirement IDs. Terms reference existing requirement_id values only -- referential integrity is validated separately (fail-closed) against the job's own Requirement rows, not by this schema.

unmodeled_branches_note.description: Optional, bounded note recording an employer-stated qualification branch this gate deliberately does not model (e.g. a certification branch whose exact remaining-experience arithmetic the employer source does not state explicitly). Must never be used to invent the unmodeled branch's arithmetic.

expression.description: A leaf is a bare requirement_id string. A non-leaf node is {op, terms}. V1 conservative scope: CASE_D/CASE_E author only ALL_OF/ANY_OF, per the ADR's locked operator-scope decision -- AT_LEAT_N/NOT remain part of the shared shape (for schema/evaluator reuse) but must not be authored for any qualification_gate until a real employer source requires them.
